```yaml
name: Update Lint Config

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 0 * * 1' # Runs every Monday at 00:00 UTC
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  update-lint-config:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@v2
        with:
          go-version: '1.17'

      - name: Download and apply local lint config
        run: |
          cp .golangci.yml .golangci.local.yml
          make lint

      - name: Check for upstream changes
        id: check-changes
        run: |
          git diff --quiet origin/main .golangci.yml || echo "::set-output name=has_changes::true"

      - name: Create PR if changes exist
        if: ${{ steps.check-changes.outputs.has_changes == 'true' }}
        uses: peter-evans/create-pull-request@v3
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          commit-message: "chore: update lint config"
          title: "Update lint config"
          body: "This PR updates the lint configuration based on the latest upstream changes."
          branch: "lint-config-update"
          delete_branch_on_merge: true
```
